metadata.description: The flat case: model has no subpath entry points, so it is the sole writer of dist/packages/model and `build` is simply its compile plus the ESM finalize. The nested `npx nx run model:build-base` command it used to shell out to is now a dependsOn edge, so this runs inside ONE Nx process and one task graph instead of spawning a second one that shares no scheduling or dedup with the first.

`^build`, NOT the `^build-base` @nx/rollup/plugin infers: @nx/js remaps @dereekb/* imports to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports` -- and rollup writes `.` as {import, types} until the dependency's own `build` reorders it. `^build-base` would compile this package against un-finalized dependencies.
